name: AdCP 3.2 Content-Digest header does not match SHA-256 of received body
spec_reference: #verifier-checklist-requests step 11; AdCP 3.2 profile per #content-digest-and-proxy-compatibility and #adcp-rfc-9421-profile binary value encoding
$comment: 3.2-profile counterpart of negative/010-content-digest-mismatch.json. AdCP 3.2 profile: the signature covers content-digest, binary values use RFC 8941 sf-binary (standard padded Base64), and the verifier advertises covers_content_digest='required'. The Content-Digest header asserts the sha-256 of 32 zero bytes, which is not the digest of the body. The Signature IS a valid Ed25519 signature by test-ed25519-2026 over expected_signature_base (which includes the header value as sent), so step 10 passes and step 11 fails. Rejecting earlier with request_signature_invalid is non-conformant for this vector.
